book.name: Annabi Hose
book.title: Ala xa masenyi Annabi Hose bɛ Ala xa masenyi Annabi Hose bɛ

content.text: Wo fa be, won xa gbilen Alatala ma!
A bara won tɔɔrɔ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a won nayalanma nɛ.
A bara won bɔnbɔ, kɔnɔ yakɔsi a won ma fie maxirima nɛ.
Xi firin na dangi, a fama nɛ won nayalande,
a xi saxan nde a won nakeli, won fa lu a sɛɛti ma.
Won xa Alatala fen, won xa a kolon.
Ala fafe mu kanama.
Lɔxɔ yo lɔxɔ kuye ibama, ɲɛmɛ birin tunɛ fama.
Ala fan mu tondima fade won yire.
«N munse rabama i tan na, Efirami?
N munse rabama i ra, Yudaya?
I xa hinnɛ n mabiri, luxi nɛ alɔ xini naxan goroma gɛɛsɛgɛ,
kɔnɔ beenun soge xa xɔnɔ, a ɲɔn.
N wo gerema namiɲɔnmɛe xa masenyie ra na nan ma,
n wo faxama nɛ n ma masenyie ra.
N ma kiitie fiixɛ alɔ naiyalanyi.
Hinnɛ rafan n ma dangife sɛrɛxɛ ra,
Ala kolonfe dangi sɛrɛxɛ gan daaxie ra.
E bara n ma saatɛ kana,
alɔ adamadie darixi a ra ki naxɛ.
E bara n yanfa.
Mixi ɲaaxi wuya Galadi, faxɛtie bara gbo naa.
Sɛrɛxɛdubɛe baganma mixi ma Sikemi kira xɔn ma alɔ muɲɛtie.
Na faxɛ tife, fe ɲaaxi na a ra.
N bara fe ɲaaxie to Isirayilakae tagi:
Efirami bara langoeɲa raba, Isirayila bara nɔxɔ.
Yudaya, n na gɛ n ma ɲama ragbilende konyiya kui,
n wo fan ɲaxankatama nɛ.»
